info.name: MessMate · 12 · Destructive (⚠️ hate kore chalao)
info.description:
**⚠️ Ei folder ta "Run collection"-e chalio na.** Ei request gulo seed data ba tomar nijer access noshto kore dey.

Ekta ekta kore, bujhe chalao — ar ki hobe seta prati request-er description-e lekha ache.
---

### ⚠️ Ei collection ta alada (standalone)

Alada collection-er moddhe **collection variable share hoy na**. Tai sob id
**environment**-e rakha hoy — sob collection ekei environment dekhe.

**Chalanor age:**

1. Upore daan pashe environment dropdown-e **"MessMate — Local"** select kora ache kina dekho
2. **`01 · Auth`** collection theke ei tinta chalao (ekbar chalalei jothesto):
   - `Login — Owner` → token
   - `Me` → messId, membershipId
   - `Setup — load current period` → periodId

Erpor ei collection-er request gulo kaj korbe.

**Environment select na thakle** `{{messId}}` khali theke jabe ar `400` ashbe.

exec: // Mess-er timezone (Asia/Dhaka, UTC+6) dhore date variable set kora hoy,
// jate cutoff test gulo tomar computer-er timezone-e bhul na hoy.
try { pm.environment.set("today", iso(nowDhaka)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("tomorrow", plus(1)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("plus2", plus(2)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("plus3", plus(3)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("farFuture", plus(17)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("currentMonth", iso(nowDhaka).slice(0, 7)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Password bodlay **ebong oi user-er sob active session revoke kore dey** — cookie-o clear hoy. Erpor abar login korte hobe.

**Keno session revoke:** password bodlanor mane sadharonoto "keu amar account-e dhukeche" — tai purono session beche thaka bipojjonok.

**⚠️ Ki noshto hobe:** je account-e ekhon logged in acho tar password `Messmate456` hoye jabe. Seed-er baki request gulo `Messmate123` dhore ache.

**Kibhabe ferabe:** `currentPassword: "Messmate456"`, `newPassword: "Messmate123"` diye abar chalao.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Tumi MANAGER hoye jabe ar target member OWNER hobe — **ek transaction-e**. Tai kokhono duijon owner, ba shunno owner hoy na.

**⚠️ Ki noshto hobe:** tumi ar OWNER thakbe na — reopen, role change, ownership transfer ar korte parbe na.

**Kibhabe ferabe:** notun owner-er account-e login kore ulto transfer chalao.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Refresh session revoke kore ar cookie clear kore.

**Note:** token bhul ba expired holeo `200` dey — logout kokhono fail kora uchit na.

**⚠️ Erpor:** abar "01 · Auth → Login — Owner" chalate hobe.

**Expect:** `200`
